source_citation: TRANSPARENT ASSUMPTION (see docs/decisions.md #030): JICA HAIDEP final report (March 2007) provides design speeds (motorway=100, primary=80, secondary=60, tertiary=40 km/h), not observed motorcycle speeds. No verified Hanoi motorway motorcycle travel-speed source identified. Son et al. (2012) report highway peak/non-peak Hanoi motorcycle speeds of 36.6/48.5 km/h; the current 45.0 km/h falls within that range but is not directly derived from it. Value is a modeling assumption; see docs/decisions.md #030 for follow-up requirements.

TRANSPARENT ASSUMPTION (see docs/decisions.md #030): HAIDEP contains no verified motorcycle-specific operating-speed observation for trunk corridors. Son et al. (2012) arterial peak/non-peak: 16.2/33.6 km/h; these are considerably lower than 44.0. Current value is a modeling assumption; reviewers should treat arterial speeds as uncertain and consult motorcycle_speed_sensitivity outputs.

TRANSPARENT ASSUMPTION (see docs/decisions.md #030): no verified per-road-class source. Value broadly consistent with Son et al. (2012) upper arterial range (33.6 km/h non-peak) as a loose ceiling; OSM class-to-paper-category mapping unverified. Modeling assumption only.

TRANSPARENT ASSUMPTION (see docs/decisions.md #030): same disposition as primary. Son et al. arterial range 16.2–33.6 km/h; 35.2 is slightly above the observed non-peak arterial mean. Modeling assumption only.

TRANSPARENT ASSUMPTION (see docs/decisions.md #030): no verified tertiary-specific source. Son et al. (2012) residential peak/non-peak 23.5/26.7 km/h provides a partial residential lower bound; tertiary is assumed faster. Modeling assumption only.

TRANSPARENT ASSUMPTION (see docs/decisions.md #030): Son et al. (2012) Fig. 11: Hanoi residential motorcycle speed 26.7 km/h non-peak and 23.5 km/h peak. Current 22.0 km/h is slightly below the observed peak mean (23.5); it serves as a conservative lower-bound assumption. Not a direct citation.
TRANSPARENT ASSUMPTION: unclassified roads in the Ocean Park area treated as residential-analogous. No external source. OSM unclassified is not empirically equated with Hanoi residential roads.
TRANSPARENT ASSUMPTION: geometry- and access-constrained speed. No verified Hanoi or Vietnam service-road motorcycle-speed source.

TRANSPARENT ASSUMPTION: pedestrian-priority setting. Previous citation to TCVN 9817:2013 was erroneous (that standard concerns X-ray fluorescence analysis of iron ore, not road speeds). Thong tu 38/2024/TT-BGTVT gives a 50-60 km/h legal maximum for ordinary motorcycles on urban roads — a legal maximum, not a representative travel speed for living streets. Current 9.0 km/h is a modeling assumption only.
TRANSPARENT ASSUMPTION: deterministic fallback for unrecognised OSM highway tags. Residential-equivalent speed. No external source.
